Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow PLC 23 November 2026 23 November 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 16 November 2026 to 20 November 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 16 Nov 2026 610,128 329.0000 320.9000 325.0134 LSE 17 Nov 2026 623,052 319.7000 316.0000 317.6190 LSE 18 Nov 2026 631,113 321.6000 313.1000 317.6350 LSE 19 Nov 2026 624,219 323.4000 316.5000 318.5166 LSE 20 Nov 2026 631,711 317.0000 311.1000 314.0461 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 48,724,941 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,361,795,312 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,361,795,312. A schedule of individual trades carried out by Barclays as principal during the Disclosure Period pursuant to the Buyback Programme is set out below.
